title: Adopt assistant-ui for Chatticus workspace chat UX
description:
## Decision (2026-09-14)
Go straight to **assistant-ui** for the Chatticus workspace conversation surface (not Phase-1-only AI Elements / shadcn MessageScroller).

## Why
We need production chat UX (Thread, Composer, streaming, tool/approval-ready primitives) while keeping Chatticus durable messaging, SSE turns, orgs, bots, and computers.

## Integration path
Use **ExternalStoreRuntime** (`useExternalStoreRuntime`): Chatticus owns messages + turn stream; assistant-ui renders Thread/Composer.
Docs: https://www.assistant-ui.com/docs/runtimes/custom/external-store
Overview: https://www.assistant-ui.com/docs/runtimes/custom/overview
Pick-a-runtime: https://www.assistant-ui.com/docs/runtimes/pick-a-runtime

## Non-goals
- Do not adopt CopilotKit / AG-UI as the product protocol
- Do not replace Chatticus messaging/SSE/org APIs with AI SDK useChat as source of truth
- Do not require assistant-cloud

## Success
Signed-in workspace conversation uses assistant-ui Thread + ExternalStoreRuntime over existing postMessage + openTurnStream; roster/inspector/computer can stay Chatticus chrome initially.
